channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Toffoli adia votação do registro de Renan Santos por indício de 'ilucitude'
item.description: Minister Dias Toffoli removed from the TSE agenda the vote on Renan Santos' (Mission) presidential candidacy registration, citing potential irregularities. The decision was announced following an analysis by the minister himself.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro elogia modelo de segurança de Bukele após reunião com ministro salvadorenho
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro praises Bukele's security model after meeting with Salvadoran minister. The senator calls the strict stance against crime 'inspiring'. The discussion takes place amid debates on public security strategies.

item.title: Flávio se reúne com ministro da Justiça de Bukele e se diz inspirado
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro meets with El Salvador's Justice Minister and says he is inspired to create a public security plan in Brazil, proposing a dedicated ministry and strategies similar to those of Nayib Bukele.

item.title: Toffoli vê “indícios de ilicitudes” no registro de Renan Santos e adia julgamento
item.description: TSE minister Dias Toffoli postponed the hearing of Renan Santos's (Mission) presidential candidacy registration after detecting signs of irregularities in the submitted information. The case will undergo detailed judicial review.

item.title: Toffoli aponta ilicitudes e trava análise de registro de candidatura de Renan Santos
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Dias Toffoli, of the TSE, suspended the analysis of Renan Santos' presidential candidacy after identifying potential irregularities. The candidate allegedly registered 18 social media accounts after the deadline set by electoral law, which may violate regulations regarding the communication of electronic sites used for electoral propaganda.

item.title: No RS, Zema defende ampliação do Seguro Agrícola: "Estado precisa acordar"
item.description: During a campaign stop in Rio Grande do Sul, Romeu Zema advocated for expanding crop insurance and criticized the current coverage, noting farmers lost harvests without state support. He also accused the Ministry of Agrarian Development of funding land invasion movements.

item.title: Jingle na Bahia é adaptado contra Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: An AI-generated jingle originally targeting Bahia gubernatorial candidates ACM Neto and Jerônimo Rodrigues has been adapted to attack Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, PL presidential candidate. The song uses regional slang like 'pega na cabeça do meu pau' and 'pega na cabeça da minha pica' to criticize allegations of corruption, ties to Banco Master, and Jair Bolsonaro's arrest.

item.title: Jingles viram arsenal contra ACM Neto e Jerônimo na Bahia
item.description: AI-generated jingles are going viral and use Bahia slang to criticize ACM Neto, Jerônimo, and Flávio Bolsonaro. The gubernatorial race remains statistically tied in the latest Quaest poll, with 42% and 41% of voting intentions.

item.title: Toffoli cita "ilicitudes" e adia julgamento do registro de Renan Santos
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Dias Toffoli postponed the hearing on the candidacy registration of Renan Santos for president after detecting 'signs of illegalities' related to social media profiles listed by Santos and his running mate, Aroldo Medina. The decision aims to review potential violations of electoral rules regarding social media use in campaigns. The hearing, scheduled for August 31st, was removed from the virtual plenary agenda of the Court.

item.title: Toffoli cita 'indícios de ilicitude' em registro de Renan Santos e adia análise de candidatura
item.description: TSE Minister Dias Toffoli identified signs of illegality in the candidacy registration of Renan Santos, from the 'Mission to the Presidency' slate, and ordered the process removed from the agenda. The decision affects an initial review scheduled for this week. Toffoli highlighted that the slate only disclosed 18 social media profiles after the deadline, failing to declare all communication channels at the time of registration, as required by electoral law.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz ter poucos presos no Brasil e promete criar Ministério da Segurança, se eleito
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro proposed creating 500,000 prison spots and a Ministry of Public Security, modeled after El Salvador, and pledged to cut public spending through technology.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro rejeita voto casado com Eduardo Paes e critica candidato ao governo do Rio: 'cupincha de Lula'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro rejected a joint vote with Eduardo Paes, labeling him a 'Lula lackey' and endorsing Douglas Ruas for Rio's governorship. The presidential candidate criticized the alliance between Paes and the PT, claiming he seeks votes for the PT and the continuation of the federal government.

item.title: A proposta da Flávio Bolsonaro sobre o fim da escala 6×1
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro proposes replacing the 6×1 shift system with a remuneration model based on actual hours worked, allowing employees to choose their workload according to personal needs, such as women balancing childcare responsibilities. The initiative preserves labor rights while increasing flexibility in work schedules.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro se encontra com ministro de Bukele e diz que Brasil tinha que prender mais
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, PL presidential candidate, praised Nayib Bukele's security policies during a meeting with El Salvador's Minister of Justice, Gustavo Villatoro. He defended increasing prison population in Brazil and criticized legislation, proposing over half a million new prison spots.

item.title: Flávio diz se inspirar em modelo de Bukele em El Salvador e afirma que Brasil ‘tem pouco preso’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro claimed Brazil has too few prisoners and cited Nayib Bukele's model in El Salvador as inspiration to increase incarceration, after meeting with the country's Minister of Justice and Public Security. He proposes creating 500,000 prison slots and five federal maximum-security units, dismissing human rights violation accusations tied to the Salvadoran state of emergency.

item.title: Congresso terá semana decisiva sobre fim da 6×1 e taxa das blusinhas
item.description: The National Congress will review this week several high-impact social projects, including the end of the 6×1 work schedule and the tax exemption on international purchases up to 50 dollars. The constitutional amendment ending the six-day workweek is set for discussion at the Senate's CCJ, while the provisional measure eliminating the so-called 'shirt tax' will be processed in the Chamber of Deputies.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro defende texto alternativo à PEC do fim da 6x1
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro defended an alternative text to the PEC that eliminates the 6×1 shift, proposing hourly pay and allowing workers to choose their workload. The 6×1 abolition PEC was approved in the Chamber and is advancing in the Senate with a favorable opinion from rapporteur Omar Aziz. Flávio did not directly position himself on voting for the PEC, choosing instead to promote the PL's alternative proposal.

item.title: Evento de Flávio tem acidente entre barco e jet ski dos Bombeiros
item.description: A pro-Flávio Bolsonaro boat parade in Angra dos Reis (RJ) saw a collision between a Fire Department jet ski and a participant boat, requiring rescues. The event featured allies such as Douglas Ruas, Carlos Portinho and Alfredo Gaspar, and discussed nuclear energy, oil and environmental licensing.

item.title: Toffoli adia julgamento do registro de candidatura de Renan Santos e aponta indícios de ilicitude
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Dias Toffoli postponed the ruling on Renan Santos' presidential candidacy registration, citing signs of illegality for failing to report all social media accounts during the filing. The slate of Renan and his running mate, Aroldo Medina, reported 18 social media profiles only in August, after the legal deadline.

item.title: Campanha de Lula faz ofensiva no TSE contra Flávio Bolsonaro, Caiado e Zema por postagens e discursos
item.description: The Brazil of Hope Federation, composed of PT, PV, and PCdoB, filed lawsuits at the TSE challenging posts and speeches by Flávio Bolsonaro, Caiado, and Zema for spreading false information and abusing power at the 2026 Barretos Rodeo Festival. The accusations involve use of artificial intelligence for disinformation and political attacks in the electoral campaign.

item.title: A crítica do humorista Paulo Vieira a uma das sabatinas na Globo
item.description: Comedian Paulo Vieira criticized the handling of Flávio Bolsonaro's interview on Globo, claiming the hosts failed to interrupt or challenge the candidate's statements regarding money received from Daniel Vorcaro. Vieira pointed out that there were no immediate explanations or context provided during the interview, particularly when Flávio referenced not using the Lei Rouanet as justification.

item.title: Kakay: Flávio Bolsonaro oscilou entre a mentira e a ignorância na Globo
item.description: The article criticizes Flávio Bolsonaro's stance during an interview with Globo, noting he avoided being questioned about lies and controversial acts, such as the decoration of Adriano da Nóbrega, presenting a calm demeanor that contrasts with the rigorous tone used in the interview with Lula. The author accuses the moderators of passivity and questions the candidate's ethics and truthfulness.

item.title: 'Tem pouco preso no Brasil', diz Flávio Bolsonaro após encontro com ministro da Segurança de El Salvador
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro met with El Salvador's Minister of Justice and Public Security, Gustavo Villatoro, to discuss strategies against organized crime, drawing inspiration from the country's security model. He claimed Brazil has too few prisoners and advocated for the creation of over half a million prison spots with stricter laws to reduce gang influence. Bolsonaro also emphasized technology to isolate inmates and turn prisons from 'crime schools' into exemplary facilities.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro encontra ministro de Bukele, ignora violações e diz que há poucos presos no Brasil
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), presidential candidate, met with El Salvador's Justice and Public Security Minister Gustavo Villatoro in São Paulo, praising the country's security approach and downplaying political arrests in Brazil.

item.title: Candidato ao Planalto quer criar “Meu Botox, Minha Vida”
item.description: Wilson Grassi proposes 'My Botox, My Life,' offering free Botox to low-income women, funded by a tax on cosmetics and cutting electoral campaign financing. Other measures include replacing nine federal taxes with a 2% financial transaction tax, abolishing the CLT, and increasing the Bolsa Família, but revoking beneficiaries' voting rights. He advocates regulating mining on indigenous lands.

item.title: Ex-comandante da FAB diz que Flávio Bolsonaro foi ‘leviano’ ao acusá-lo de pedir votos para Lula
item.description: Former Air Force commander Carlos de Almeida Baptista Junior labeled as 'levity' Flávio Bolsonaro's claim that he was campaigning for Lula. The dispute arose during a TV Globo interview, where Flávio avoided commenting on reports of pressures for a 2022 coup. Baptista Junior suggested Flávio should wait for the release of his book 'Eu disse não' before making further statements.

item.title: Julgamentos bilionários, Justiça gratuita e Testemunha de Jeová: a pauta do STF para setembro
item.description: The STF released its September agenda featuring billionaire-impact rulings, particularly in taxation, such as Funrural and ICMS, along with debates on health, technology, and customs, including cases involving religion and regulated professions. Topics like ride-hailing regulation and the Rio de Janeiro interim mandate elections were removed from the agenda. The month precedes the 2026 elections, heightening the significance of the rulings.

item.title: Lula vai usar desfile de 7 de setembro para divulgar pautas sociais
item.description: President Lula will use the September 7th parade to promote social agendas in his electoral campaign, such as combating femicide and encouraging vaccination. The event will feature traditional military displays and highlight the upcoming Women's World Cup.

item.title: Lei Rouanet acelera sob Lula e capta R$ 10,7 bilhões desde 2023
item.description: Lei Rouanet has secured R$ 10.7 billion in funding since 2023, exceeding the four-year total under Bolsonaro, with R$ 1.18 billion released in 2026. Demand from projects and sponsors will guide the expansion of the tax waiver ceiling, according to the Ministry of Culture, which views culture as investment rather than spending. An FGV study shows that each R$ 1 invested through fiscal incentives generates significant economic returns, reinforcing the program under Lula's third term.

item.title: SP e RJ concentram mais da metade da Lei Rouanet em 2026
item.description: In 2026, R$118.9 million was released via Rouanet Law for state cultural projects, with São Paulo (R$383.9 million) and Rio de Janeiro (R$301.9 million) accounting for nearly half. The Lula administration directs funds to under-supported regions like the North, Northeast, and rural areas. Annual collection exceeds R$3 billion, totaling R$10.7 billion since 2023.

item.title: Cury propõe influenciadores em embaixadas para promover o Brasil
item.description: During an interview on Jornal Nacional, presidential candidate Augusto Cury (Avante) proposed training embassy staff to act as digital influencers to promote Brazil's image abroad. The idea is part of an agenda involving reforms in diplomatic action and international communication.

item.title: Pesquisas eleitorais mostram a distância entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro após números da semana
item.description: Recent polls show a technical tie between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, with minor numerical fluctuations keeping the presidential race balanced. The BTG/Nexus places Lula at 46% and Flávio at 45% in a hypothetical second round, while Vox Brasil inverts the order, with Flávio at 45.1% and Lula at 44.5%. Both surveys reflect a trend toward convergence between the two candidates in recent weeks.

item.title: A resposta de Baptista Júnior a Flávio Bolsonaro após ser acusado de apoiar Lula
item.description: Former Air Force commander Carlos de Almeida Baptista Júnior rejected Flávio Bolsonaro's accusations of supporting Lula's re-election, calling the claim 'levity' and emphasizing his statements to the STF and in his book did not focus on Flávio. Flávio downplayed reports of coup risks during the Bolsonaro administration in a TV Globo interview.

item.title: Quando saem as próximas pesquisas sobre a disputa Lula x Flávio
item.description: Four national surveys on the race between Lula and Flávio will be released between August 31 and September 3. The polls will assess first-round and runoff scenarios, along with indicators such as voter motivation, candidate rejection, and perceptions of the economy and Lula's government.

item.title: Caiado: “Sou agro raiz, Flávio é sabor agro”
item.description: Former governor Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) claimed during a speech at the Barretos Rodeo Festival that he would defeat Lula (PT) in a potential presidential runoff. He emphasized his 'agro roots' profile and highlighted an alliance with Flávio Dino, referred to as 'agro flavor'.

item.title: 'Currículo' de Flávio vai à TV e viraliza nas redes na campanha de Lula
item.description: Lula's campaign released a video attacking Flávio Bolsonaro's record, which trended on social media with 10 million views. The ad will remain on TV until tomorrow per the PT campaign's directive.

item.title: Mulher na urna, homem no poder
item.description: The text emphasizes the role of women in the 2026 electoral decision, contrasting female presence at the polls with male dominance in the exercise of power. Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are mentioned as candidates whose outcome depends on the female vote.

item.title: Projeto reforça validade de mensagens compartilhadas como prova
item.description: Bill 3349/26 amends the Criminal Procedure Code to allow messaging app conversations to be used as evidence when voluntarily shared by one participant, excluding content obtained through illegal means. The proposal aims to align legislation with technological evolution and TSE jurisprudence, citing a 2024 vote-buying case. The bill has expedited processing and requires approval by both the Chamber and Senate.

item.title: Depois de agradecer a Trump, Flávio mente no JN e empurra culpa a Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro lied on Journal Nacional about Trump tariffs, hiding that his family supported and publicly thanked the US president. The caucus debunked the farce, recalling that while brother Eduardo celebrated, Brazil is the one paying. The senator tried to blame Lula, but only further evidenced putting family interests above the country.

item.title: Campanha presidencial errática de Zema ameaça até o futuro do partido Novo
item.description: Romeu Zema's (Novo) presidential campaign has been marked by solitary appearances and low support, with around 3% of voting intentions, according to Datafolha. His public appearances at fairs and events highlight criticism of the government and fiscal adjustment proposals, but fail to mobilize voters or attract allies.

item.title: 7 candidatos à Presidência recebem segurança da PF nas eleições
item.description: Seven of the thirteen presidential candidates accepted Federal Police protection during the electoral campaign, with the operation costing R$ 95 million. Flávio Bolsonaro, Rui Costa Pimenta, and Hertz Dias rejected the protection due to distrust in the PF or because they consider the risk low. The PF offers mandatory institutional protection to all candidates, even if some choose not to accept it.

item.title: Lula mistura governo e campanha na busca pela reeleição
item.description: Lula blends government and campaign activities for reelection, with the finance minister and communicators serving in both roles simultaneously, prompting criticism over the use of state resources for electoral purposes.

item.title: Reaproximação de Alcolumbre e Lula vai destravar indicações para agências e BC
item.description: The rapprochement between Davi Alcolumbre and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva may ease the progress of appointments to regulatory agencies and the Central Bank board, particularly after polls open in November. This strategic alliance brings together key figures from the Congress leadership and the federal executive.

item.title: Real Madrid x Málaga na La Liga: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: Real Madrid, led by José Mourinho, faces promoted Málaga in La Liga's third round at 12pm Brasília time at Santiago Bernabéu, broadcasted by CazéTV. The Merengue team is coming off a 4-1 win over Real Sociedad with standout performances from Mbappé and Vinícius Júnior. Málaga seeks its first win after a draw and loss in their season opener.

item.title: Pesquisas eleitorais já custaram R$ 109 milhões em 2026
item.description: The TSE recorded 1,824 electoral polls in 2026, totaling R$ 109 million and 2.8 million respondents from 173 institutes. The data reflects the high cost and volume of research for the municipal elections.

item.title: Planos de governo de Flávio Bolsonaro, ACM Neto e outros usam expressão típica de IA
item.description: Six out of 211 government plans from presidential and gubernatorial candidates use the phrase 'loose promises,' with half of them showing typical AI-generated constructions. Among those mentioned are Flávio Bolsonaro and ACM Neto, suggesting AI usage in policy formulation. The analysis indicates a growing trend of automation in political content creation.

item.title: Brasil tem 14,4 milhões de pessoas com deficiência, mas só 499 são candidatos em 2026
item.description: Despite 14.4 million Brazilians with disabilities, only 499 candidates declared a disability for the 2026 elections, representing 2.4% of candidacies. Most are white men with physical disabilities, while women and people with intellectual or psychosocial disabilities remain underrepresented. The issue is addressed through the free online course 'Capacitismo' by ENSP/Fiocruz.

item.title: Flávio, como foi?
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's interview on the Jornal Nacional was divisive among readers, with 66.2% rating it 'bad' in a poll of 1,138 responses. However, 22% viewed his performance positively. The content also includes analyses of political and cultural challenges.

item.title: Dez anos depois, impeachment de Dilma ainda não terminou
item.description: In 2026, ten years will have passed since the impeachment of Dilma Rousseff, an episode that, although following constitutional procedures, remains controversial regarding the balance between law and politics in Brazil. The 2016 crisis disrupted the stability of presidential terms and fostered distrusts that still shape the political landscape.

item.title: Minas estreia em 2026 a política do ‘vai não vai’ num cenário sem precedentes
item.description: Minas Gerais faces unprecedented political uncertainty in 2026, with traditional and outsider figures oscillating between candidacies. The 'go no go' phenomenon reflects the weakening of historical parties and the impact of social media on the electoral arena.
